574-6662-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a 2/2 green Bird creature token with its own landfall ability
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-6662-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3175-4247-8207.description:

When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

5254-5686-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5686-8122.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
5254-5686-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

1170-4908-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

654-851-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2292-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

573-872-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

2583-4365-4636.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens due to Mondrak.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1987-2556-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2556-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2556-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4872-7309-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Don & Leo.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3605-4812-6553-6798.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3996-4050-6441.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.

1726-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.

Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Ardent Elementalist.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Ardent Elementalist with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Ardent Elementalist tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control at least three creatures.
1399-1606-3457-6984.description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo, Waking Haven.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

222-527-6797-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6797-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.

Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.

488-641-1492-4708-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2921-3090-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:

2921-3090-5434-5555.description:

During the opponent's turn, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer
2059-2440-4183-5115.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
When the token Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

Cast Skyblade's Boon by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Skyblade's Boon spell.
Activate Skyblade's Boon by paying {2}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling, untapping a basic land.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.

450-4724.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
450-4724.notablePrerequisites: The amount of creature cards in your graveyard plus the number of Spirits in your library is equal to or greater than twenty.

When Iname enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to search your library for up to 20 Spirits and put them into your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mortal Combat triggers, causing you to win the game.

662-678-4497-4853.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
662-678-4497-4853.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Slobad to become an artifact creature until end of turn.

Dross Scorpion dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Slobad.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Dross Scorpion by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding {B}.

Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, targeting Activated Sleeper.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

1684-2178-3000-4050.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.

Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it to create an Elemental token with haste and a Squirrel token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a token, adding {R}.
